caseName: Perricone v. New York State Commission Against Discrimination
caseNameFull: Perricone v. New York State Commission Against Discrimination
attorneys: Petitioner pro se. Evelyn E. West was on the stipulation for the New York State Commission Against Discrimination, appellee. With her on a Motion to Dismiss or Affirm was Milton Rosenberg. Samuel W. Eager, appellee, pro se, was also on the stipulation.

opinions.text: Appeal from the Court of Appeals of New York. Dismissed per stipulation pursuant to Rule 60 of the Rules of this Court.
